focused_reviews.finding: The paper title mentions benomyl, but all six pinned source associations map to thiabendazole. P10653 identifies reference benA/AN1182 in FGSC A4; its EMBL cross-reference includes source identifier CBF87981.1. This is reference-locus metadata, not a G191 experimental-allele crosswalk.
focused_reviews.search_scope: Title/DOI and author/institutional searches including Ohio State and Kansas did not yield accessible primary Results in this pass; not proof that no manuscript exists.

focused_reviews.access_observation: HAL returned an access-denied HTML page, not a PDF. The publisher full-text link redirected to its abstract. Bibliographic existence of an open manuscript is not successful retrieval.
focused_reviews.finding: Q6X9S4 is reference cob/cytB with a sequence-submission strain comment ST1/MBC. The source labels IPO323 and 37-16 are not established as accession-specific experimental subjects by those metadata.

limitations: The pending queue retains source identifiers as unverified mappings, not experimentally validated resistance determinants.
Primary-access observations were made with the web tool; no locally cached full text or replayable primary review is asserted.
Database entry and sequence versions identify reference metadata, not experimental allele versions.
No new allele, sequence, construct, assay, numeric resistance measurement, genome or experimental TaxID was curated.
No NCBI endpoint requests, outreach, terms reassessment, source adoption or GitHub mutations.
Whole-corpus investigation remains incomplete; full QC remains blocked by the unchanged RDKit environment limitation.
